note: C3 normalize-distance: one new renderer/js production service (r3-0c-normalized-distance.js) canonicalizes a single lap's raw (distance, time) series into a [0,1] normalized axis. Sixteen NORMALIZED_DISTANCE_* reason codes are added to contracts/r3.0c/reason-codes.js (35 total — 16 mandated + 3 scope/metric extensions + 16 C3 extensions). The contract gains evaluateNormalizeDistanceRequestShape (structural first layer) and exposes ACCEPTED_DISTANCE_UNITS / ACCEPTED_DIRECTIONS / ACCEPTED_WRAP_SEMANTICS / ACCEPTED_MONOTONICITY / ACCEPTED_DUPLICATE_POSITION_POLICIES / ACCEPTED_ENDPOINT_CONVENTIONS / C3_NORMALIZE_REASON_CODES closed allowlists. The production service applies caller-supplied policy thresholds (no implicit defaults — the contract forces presence), refuses caller-forged authority status (NORMALIZED_DISTANCE_AUTHORITY_FORGED), refuses extrapolation beyond observed sample range (NORMALIZED_DISTANCE_EXTRAPOLATION_REQUIRED), permits at most one legal start/finish wrap (MULTIPLE_WRAPS otherwise), and emits only reason codes from C3_NORMALIZE_REASON_CODES. Thresholds inherit the C2 calibration matrix (coverage 0.95 / minimumSamples 200 / normalizedMaxGap 0.02 / timeGapSeconds 0.5, calibrationStatus 'fixture_derived_pending_field_validation'); every eligible result carries the limitation 'thresholds_fixture_calibrated_not_field_validated' on its evidence side-channel so downstream credibility cannot upgrade calibration beyond fixture support. Adapter normalizeDistance / normalizeAtTarget / normalizedDistanceDefaultThresholds / normalizedDistanceAcceptedUnits are pure passthroughs. No UI, no feature activation, no reference selection, no corner segmentation, no corner pairing, no delta metric, no export — those remain locked behind C4..C8. State-aware validators (scripts/check-r3-0c-no-consumer.js, scripts/check-r3-0c-guard.js) generalized at C1 automatically extend allowance to the new renderer/js path via governance/r3.0c/state.json.authorizedProductionPaths — NO validator weakening at C3. The trusted-verification artifact bound to headSha is the PASS authority; headSha / workflowRunId / artifactId / artifactBoundSha / codexVerdict / createdAt are intentionally null in-commit.
